en: Outer Title: Catalogue of Sūtras, Vinaya, Śāstras, Commentaries, Records, and Non-Buddhist Texts Acquired in Fuzhou, Wenzhou, and Taizhou;

Compiled by the Japanese Monk Enchin on a Mission for the Dharma. Within this catalogue, those deposited at Guoqing Temple total four hundred and thirty fascicles; furthermore, [fascicles] were obtained from his home country.

The future total shall comprise five hundred and eighty-two fascicles in fifty-two volumes; this was recorded by Zhen on the second day of the ninth month in the eighth year of the Dazhong era while staying at Tiantai. From his travels through Fuzhou, Wenzhou, and Taizhou, he obtained scriptures, vinayas, śāstras, commentaries, sub-commentaries, and secular works, totaling four hundred and fifty-eight fascicles.

*Fajing jing* (Sūtra on the Dharma Mirror), one fascicle; *Dasheng fangdeng yaohui jing* (Mahāyāna Vaipulya Sūtra of Essential Wisdom), one fascicle; *Dafangguang jin xiansuo shuo jing* (Mahāvaipulya Sūtra Spoken by Jin-xian), one fascicle;
*Dasheng jingangji zhu pusa xiuxing fen* (Mahāyāna Sūtra on the Section of the Bodhisattva Practice of the Vajracūḍamaṇi), one fascicle;

*Ru dingding yin jing* (Sūtra on the Seal of Entering Certainty and Uncertainty), one fascicle; *Bukong juansuo tuoluoni jing* (Amoghapāśa Dhāraṇī Sūtra), one fascicle; *Tianwang jing* (Sūtra of the Heavenly Kings), one fascicle.

*Suishen zuimiao shengding jing* (Sūtra on the Most Wondrous and Supreme Samādhi Carried Along with One), one fascicle; *Zhu wuai dabei xin tuoluoni* (Commentary on the Dhāraṇī of Unobstructed Great Compassion), one fascicle; *Miaofa lianhua jing lun* (Treatise on the Lotus Sūtra), one fascicle;

*Suishen xianyang shengjiao lun song* (Verses on the Treatise on the Manifestation of the Holy Teachings Carried Along with One), one fascicle; *Wuxiang lun* (Treatise on Non-Characteristics), two fascicles;

*Shangxia yinming zhenglimen lun* (Treatise on the Gate of Right Reasoning in Logic, Upper and Lower), one fascicle; translated by Yijing: *Dacheng guang wu...* (The Mahāyāna Extensive Five... [text fragment].
*Skandha-śāstra*, one fascicle; *Daodun’s Commentary*, six fascicles (one set); *Great Zhou Catalogue of Various Scriptures*, two fascicles (upper and lower);

*Flower Garland Ocean of Meaning*, two fascicles (upper and lower); *Portable Chan Gate*, one fascicle; *Biographies and Epitaphs of the Seven Patriarchs*, one fascicle; [duplicate] thirteen fascicles;
*Diagram of the Eight Consciousnesses and Three Bodies*, one fascicle; *Profound Discourse on the Lotus Sūtra*, one fascicle. *Dharma*... [text ends].
*Huakewen* (Flower-Category Texts), two fascicles; *Jiangxiang Jingmingjing Guanzhongshu Luesuyi tu* (Jiangxiang’s Commentary on the Vimalakīrtinirdeśa-sūtra from Guanzhong:

A Brief Diagram of Several Meanings), one fascicle; *Jinsi guanyuan* (The Contemplation of the Golden Lion), one fascicle; *Baqiyi hai tie* (Seal of the Ocean of Eight Meanings), one fascicle; *Sifenglü yinxun* (Phonetic Transcriptions for the Dharmaguptaka-vinaya), one fascicle;

*Sizhou heshang bianxiang yipu* (A Set of Transformation Images of the Upādhyāya of Sizhou), one fascicle; and *Miao Fuzhou Kaiyuansi Xinzhao futu bei bing xu* (Inscription and Preface for the Newly Constructed Stupa at Kaiyuan Temple in Fuzhou), one fascicle.
At Kaiyuan Temple, a Pure Land Hall was constructed and all the scriptures were transcribed;

one scroll containing the inscription and preface for the Tripitaka stele, as well as one scroll of the "Record of the Rebuilding of the Sutra Repository Hall by the Military Commissioner," have been transcribed above.

One bundle of *bodhi* leaves containing Sanskrit-script mantras from the Great Nālandā Monastery in Central India; one bundle of Sanskrit-script *Amoghapāśa-hṛdaya-dhāraṇī* for personal use; and a small, one-inch-long *vajra* for personal use. These were offered by the Brahmin Tripiṭaka Master Aśvarya Mañju-susthira at Kaiyuan Temple in Fufu.

One scroll of the Avalokiteśvara Cintāmaṇicakra Bodhisattva Image; one scroll of the *Śūraṅgama-samādhi Dhāraṇī* (translated by Paramārtha); one scroll of the Commentary on the *Prajñāpāramitā-hṛdaya Sūtra* (attributed to Śikṣānanda);
twenty scrolls of the New Commentary on the *Avataṃsaka Sūtra* composed by Fazang;

ten scrolls of the *Avataṃsaka Sūtra* New Commentary (by Chengguan, Vol. 1 of the Da-zhong edition); ten scrolls of the *Xiaoshen Fahua Xuanzan*; ten scrolls of the *Fahua Jing Shu* (by Zhikai); and ten scrolls of the *Da-zhong Niepan Jing Shu*.

One fascicle of the Commentary on the *Mahā-amitābha-sūtra* by Dazhong; two fascicles of the *Qiji Pusa jie shu* (Exposition on the Arising of the Bodhisattva Precepts), in upper and lower parts; three fascicles of the *Guanzhong shu* (Commentary from Guanzhong) on the *Vimalakīrti-nirdeśa-sūtra*, in upper, middle, and lower parts;

ten fascicles of the *Tiantai Fahua wenju* (Tiantai’s Phrases and Sentences of the Lotus Sutra) by Dade Lingduan; forty fascicles of the *Huayan jing lun* (Treatise on the Avataṃsaka Sūtra); ten fascicles of the *Kaifenqi lü zong ji* (Record Opening the School of the Four-Part Vinaya) by Upādhyāya Lining; eight fascicles of the *Dazhong hong diao fu lu* (Record of the Great Propagation of Discipline during the Dazhong Era);

ten fascicles of the *Kafenqi lü zong ji yijing* (Mirror of the Meaning of the Record Opening the School of the Four-Part Vinaya); and one fascicle of the *Kaizong xue mai chao* (Copy of the Bloodline of the Opening of the School) by Yixiong.

*Zhongda Sifen Kai zong ji* (Record of the Opening of the Sect of the Four-Part Vinaya), eight fascicles; *Da zhong zhen ben liao sifen kai zong ji* (The Authentic Text of the Zhongda for the Clarification of the Record of the Opening of the Sect of the Four-Part Vinaya), one fascicle;

*Daping Jie mo* (Great Peace Karma Rite), two fascicles; *Yixiong Jingang jing shu* (Commentary on the Diamond Sūtra by Yixiong), three fascicles; *Yong yu [Name] Zhi Za zhuan jiang ju* (Verses on the Miscellaneous Transmissions from Yong and [Name] Zhi), one fascicle; *Yixiong Sifen biqiu biqiuni sui yao xing yi* (The Essential Rituals for the Practice of Bhikṣus and Bhikṣuṇīs according to the Four-Part Vinaya by Yixiong), two fascicles;

*Quan suishen Jushe lun song shu* (Exegesis on the Verses of the Abhidharmakośa-bhāṣya according to the Capacity of the Individual), six fascicles; *Da zhong Jushe lun song shu* (Exegesis on the Verses of the Abhidharmakośa-bhāṣya according to the Zhongda).

The *Commentary on the Verses of the Abhidharmakośa-śāstra* (Abhidharmakośakārikā-bhāṣya-ṭīkā) in six fascicles; the *Record of the Commentary on the Verses of the Abhidharmakośa-śāstra* (Abhidharmakośa-śāstra-kārikā-vyākhyāna-kārikā-ṭīkā) in five fascicles; the *Excerpts from the Commentary on the Verses of the Abhidharmakośa-śāstra* (Abhidharmakośa-śāstra-kārikā-vyākhyāna-saṃgraha) in three fascicles;

the *Record of the Preface to the Abhidharmakośa-śāstra* (Abhidharmakośa-śāstra-pūrvapīṭhikā-ṭīkā) in one fascicle; and the *Poems Sent by Quànxiàng* (Quànxiàng sòng shī) in one fascicle, including two poems by Jiǎ and those by Cānlíáo—all of which were obtained at Kāiyuán Monastery and Dàzhōng Monastery in Fúzhòu.

*Mahāratnakūṭa-sūtra*, one fascicle; *Vajracchedikā-prajñāpāramitā-śāstra-kārikā*, one fascicle; *Catuḥpariṣat-vinaya-saṃgraha-kārikā*, one fascicle; the above two fascicles, plus one fascicle of the *Catuḥpariṣat-vinaya*; first, the *Bhikṣuṇī-karman*, one fascicle; and the *Karman-sūtra* by Master Sū of the Upper [Seat], one fascicle—these three were obtained at the residence of Zhang Dezhen in Hengyang County, Wenzhou.
*Laṅkāvatāra-sūtra* in four fascicles; *Commentary on the Laṅkāvatāra-sūtra* in ten fascicles; *Record of the Opening of the Fourfold Vinaya School* in ten fascicles;
*Commentary on the Verses of the Abhidharmakośa-śāstra* in six fascicles; *Record of the Verses of the Abhidharmakośa-śāstra* in five fascicles;
*Sub-commentary on the Commentary on the Verses of the Abhidharmakośa-śāstra* in four fascicles. The above are the works of the Master of the Fundamental Doctrine (Zongben Heshang).

*Shaiyu Zhaolun* (Bequeathed to Zhao’s Treatises), one fascicle; *Dian Zhaolun Kewen* (Annotated Outline of Zhao’s Treatises), one fascicle; *Zhu Banruo Xinjing* (Commentary on the Heart Sutra), one fascicle; *Wushengyi* (Meaning of Non-arising), two fascicles;
*Li Ji Fudashi Ge* (The Songs of Master Fudashi by Li Ji), one fascicle; *Renwang Jing Xinfan Kaifa* (New Translation and Exposition of the Benevolent Kings Sutra), one fascicle;
*Liang Jianoxing Ge* (Song on the Nature of the Path Realized by Liang), one fascicle. The above were bequeathed to the Great Master Zongyuan for the Mahayana.
*Upoṣadha-dharma* (One fascicle). *Bodhisattva-citta-bhūmi-śīla-sūtra* (One fascicle). The above were translated by Yijing.
*Zhengming-bajinglilun-shu* (One fascicle). *Mai-sifen-chongqing-yi* (One fascicle).
The above, including the *Heshang-shaiyu-huanyuanji* (Three fascicles) by Nanshan [Daoxuan], constitute one set.
One fascicle of the *Tiantai Fajie Cidi* (The Stages of the Dharma Realm), Volume One; one fascicle of the *Jingang Banruo Jing Jue* (Explanatory Key to the Diamond Sutra) by Master Neng;
one fascicle of the *Guansin Ji* (Verses on Contemplating the Mind) by the Sixth Patriarch Upādhyāya; one copy of the *Jingshui Zhou* (Water-Purification Mantra);

one copy of the *Dalun Jingang Zhou* (Great Wheel Vajra Mantra); one copy of the *Jingyan Zhenyan* (Pure Words Mantra); one copy of the *Buke Tuoluoni* (Supplementary Deficiency Dhāraṇī); and the *Xiuliang Fang* (Prescription for Abstaining from Grain).
One fascicle of the *Vajrakumāra-mantra*; one fascicle of the *Mantra for Establishing Boundaries Everywhere*; one fascicle of the *Mantra for Repaying the Kindness of Parents*;
one fascicle of the *Body-Protection Mantra*; one fascicle of the *Ekākṣara-rāja-mantra*;
one fascicle of the *Vajracchedikā-sūtra-mantra*; one fascicle of the *House-Blessing and Mantra*; one fascicle of the *Vajrākarṣaṇa*; and the *Names of the Eight Vajras*.
One copy of the *Vajracchedikā-prajñāpāramitā-sūtra* Repentance Ritual; the above fifteen items comprise one fascicle. One scroll of the *Suvarṇasāra-śāstra*; one leaf.
One leaf of the *Miscellaneous Questions and Answers of the Master Heze of the Southern School*; one leaf. The above were given by Xu Shisanshe.
One scroll of the *Explication of the Vajracchedikā-prajñāpāramitā-sūtra*; the upper portion is incomplete. One *Anuttara-ratna* [fragment].
*Samādhi Sūtra*, one fascicle; *The Essentials of Chan by Master Heze*, one fascicle; *Diagram of the Stages of the Vijñaptimātratāsiddhi-śāstra*, one fascicle;
*Portrait of Master Zongben*, one fascicle; *Genealogy of the Dharma Lineage*, one fascicle;
*New Copy of the Record of King Shensha*, one fascicle; *New Copy of the Poem Presented to Master Zongben*, one fascicle; *New Copy of Wenzhou* [one fascicle].
One scroll of poems on the mutual parting of clergy and laity, or alternatively titled "Thirty-six Poems on Mutual Parting in Fúwēn, Tāizhōu";
these were obtained at Wēnzhōu Yǒngjiā Jùn.

*Shangxian shi* (Poems of the Upper Immortals), seventy poems, one fascicle; *Jingdan yingluan shulu shanshengshi lianju* (Verses on the Outstanding Affairs of Lushan by Jing Dan and Yingluan in Chorus), forty-one fascicles, beginning with "Shundifeng"; *Zashi* (Miscellaneous Poems), one fascicle; *Jianyang shanshui ge* (Song of the Mountains and Waters of Jianyang), one fascicle—these above comprise one duplicate fascicle totaling one hundred and seventy-seven poems. *Qiantai dongtian mingji* (Record of the Names of the Thousand Great Cavern-Heavens), one fascicle; *Ce shiji* (Cursive Collection of Poetry), one fascicle, seventy-two poems; *Ti Lisanshen suoju wei chu zhashi* (Titled "On the Dwelling of Mr. Li": Miscellaneous Initial Poems), one fascicle, seventy-eight poems; *Ji Lou Qumou wei chu zaju* (Sent to Lou Qumou: Miscellaneous Initial Verses), one fascicle, one hundred and two poems; *Seng Gu Dazao wei chu* (Sent to Gu Dazao: Initial [Works])—these above were transcribed from a Daoist *Anxi* edition brought from Fuzhou to Wenzhou by sea.

One scroll of *Tiantai zan* (Praise of Tiantai), one scroll of old poems, and thirty verses titled "On the Immortal Altar" as a preliminary collection; these were transcribed at the residence of Qu Zonggu on Qiaoling Mountain in Taizhou.

The eight-fascicle *Mahā-śamatha-vipaśyanā* (Mohe zhiguan), lacking fascicles four and eight; a copy from the collection of Chanlin Temple; the two-fascicle *Nanshan Sifen-jie-mo* (Nanshan Four-Part Karmavācanā) in its final version; and the one-fascicle *Fuzhou Jingkou ji* (Record of the Support of Jingkou); these were previously offered by the Venerable Qingliu of Anning Temple in Huangyan County, Taizhou.

The *Yinming lun shu* (Commentary on the Treatise on Logic) in three fascicles, and the *Jinyinming shu rouchao* (Compiled Extracts from the Commentary on the Yinming) in three fascicles; these were handwritten copies by the Preceptor Qinghan at the end of the Zhenyuan era, which were already kept at Kaiyuan Temple in Taizhou. When the Venerable Jian was about to pass away, he bestowed them upon the Venerable Han, who had entered his inner chamber.

*Record of Seeking the Dharma in Japan*, one fascicle, composed by Zhijian; *Record of the Twelve Monasteries of Tiantai*, one fascicle. The above were copied at Kaiyuan Temple in Taizhou. *Verses by the Elder Jian*, one fascicle. Section C: Original texts, six new works in total; annotated *Mahāprajñāpāramitā Sūtra*, nine fascicles. Upper two [fascicles], thirty-eight, ten, thirteen, sixteen, nineteen, twenty. The above were sought and obtained from below Taizhou.

The *Tiantai Fahua Shuyi Zan* (Excerpts on the Meaning of the Tiantai Commentary on the Lotus Sutra) in six fascicles; the *Zhidu He Shangshu Tiantai Fahua Kewen* (The Reverend Zhidu’s Preface to the Tiantai Sectional Text of the Lotus Sutra) in two fascicles; the *Tiantai Shan Xiaolu* (A Brief Record of Mount Tiantai) in one fascicle, also titled *Guoqing Lingsheng Chuanmei Luefang* (Brief Account of the Transmission of the Holy and Divine at Guoqing) in fourteen fascicles in two volumes—these and others were copied from Mount Tiantai at Guoqing Temple.

One scroll of the Handwritten Manuscript by Master Benning (a), titled *Collection of Correspondence between Fuzhou*; one scroll of the *Collection of Correspondence between Wenzhou and Taizhou* (b); one scroll of the *Collection of Handwritten Manuscripts by the Elder Jian* (c);

one scroll of the *Excerpts from the Catalogue* (d); a private copy of the *Zhenyuan Catalogue of the Quest for the Dharma*; one scroll of the *Calendar of the Seven Luminaries*; one scroll of the *Collection of Imperial Edicts and Memoranda on the Brief Establishment of Monasteries Throughout the Realm*;

one scroll of the *Three Primordials and Nine Palaces*; one scroll of the *Calendar of the Seven Luminaries*; one scroll of the *Verses of the Master of West Tang*; and [the works of] Xuanzang Sanzang.

One scroll of the *Text for Paying Homage* brought from the Western Heaven by Zang; the above three scrolls constitute one fascicle. One official document (di) issued by Taizhou to the Japanese monk Enchin seeking the Dharma, to be carried on his person.
One scroll of the *Mahāpratisarā-dhāraṇī-sūtra of the Seven Koṭis of Buddhas*, translated by Tripiṭaka Master Vajrabodhi; to be carried on his person. One scroll of the *Commentary on the Two Truths:

A Collection of Explanations of the Great Sūtra*; to be carried on his person. One scroll of the *Siddham Script: A Collection of Explanations of the Great Sūtra*; to be carried on his person. One scroll of the *Method of Ritual Practice*; [and] the Ten Great Disciples of Yunhua Temple in the Capital.

One scroll of *Zàn* (Praise); the above constitutes one additional scroll; one scroll of the *Xiūchándàochǎngbēmíng* (Inscription on the Meditation Hall), composed by Liáng Bǔquè; five scrolls of the *Rìběnxiānláijí* (Collection of Japanese Precedents);
sixteen scrolls and below constitute one fascicle; three scrolls of the *Biǎojí* (Collection of Petitions); from the middle of the fifth scroll to the end of the seventh scroll, incomplete;

[records of] snow; written at Zhènxī Fǔ by Língfú Cóng; one, two, three, four, up to the middle of the fifth scroll; one scroll established due to the founding of Sāntóng Sè in Huángyán County, Tāizhōu. *Qiá*.

The *Zezhu Ji* (Record of the Abbot) in five volumes; the *Xuemai Houfen Kewen* (Postscript on the Lineage of the Sectional Texts) in one volume; the *Yumai Zhiguan Da-ke* (Lineage Chart of the Great Outline of Calming and Contemplation) in one volume;

the *Caoxi Shan Di-liu Zu Neng Dashi Tanching* (Platform Sutra of the Sixth Patriarch Master Neng of Caoxi Mountain) in one volume; the *Menren Fahai Ji Suishen Zhe Za Yaoyangfang* (Collection by the Disciple Fahai of Various Essential Prescriptions for Medicines Carried on the Person) in one volume;

the *Tiantai Shan Guoqing Si Ju Lü Dade Yingzan* (Portrait Eulogy for the Virtuous Vinaya Master of Guoqing Temple on Mount Tiantai) in one volume; the *Yi Zhang Yongjia Jue Dashi Ji* (One Scroll of the Collection of Master Jue of Yongjia) in one volume; and the *Weimo Jing Yanzheng Shu* (Commentary on the Correct Interpretation of the Vimalakīrti Sūtra) in five volumes.

The fourth fascicle is missing; the three fascicles of the *Yan-zheng-shu-chao* (Excerpts from the Commentary on the Correct Exposition) above constitute two sections. The *Jian-heshang-she-yu-Riben-Shiqian-yuanqi-xu* (Preface to the Account of the Founding Master’s Bestowal [of Works] upon the Japanese *Shiqian*) in one fascicle;

the *Damo-heshang-wuxing-lun* (Treatise on the Awakening of Nature by Master Dharmatrāta) in one fascicle; the *Suishen-Baizhangshan-heshang-yaojue* (Essential Decisions of the Master of Baizhang Mountain for Personal Use) in one fascicle; the *Shenhai-ji-suishen-song-waishang-renjing-shixu* (Collected Poems and Prefaces Sent to the Superior Man Entering the Capital by Shenhai) in one fascicle;

and the *Luhui-Zhuzi-duiyi* (Luhui’s Rites for Responding to the Imperial Edict) in one fascicle. The aforementioned two fascicles are combined into one. Also, the *Tiantai-Fahua-xuan-yi* (Tiantai’s Profound Meaning of the Lotus Sutra).

*Ke-er-juan yu-mo* (Two-Volume Sectional Outline with Pulse) *T'ien-t'ai Fa-hua-su ke-er-juan yu-mo* (One-Volume T'ien-t'ai Commentary on the Lotus Sutra with Pulse) *Fa-hua ming-hsiang* (One-Volume Names and Phrases of the Lotus Sutra) *Niu-shan i-tieh Jung-hsin lun* (One-Scroll Niu-shan Treatise on the Integration of the Mind) *Hui Ta-shih i-tieh Chin-kang pan-jo ching i* (One-Scroll Master Hui’s Single-Scroll Meaning of the Diamond Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra) *□ Ming-chi i-tieh* (One-Scroll Record of Names) *Niu-shan Wei-mo-chieh ching yao-lüeh-su* (One-Scroll Niu-shan Essential Abridged Commentary on the Vimalakīrti Sūtra) *Niu-shan Tao-ch'i-ko* (One-Scroll Niu-shan Song of the Sword) *Chin-kang ching su* (One-Scroll Commentary on the Diamond Sūtra) *T'ien-t'ai sui-shen* (T'ien-t'ai for Carrying on the Person) *T'ien-t'ai kuan-hsin lun* (One-Volume T'ien-t'ai Treatise on Contemplating the Mind) *Sui-shen ch'an* (Carrying-on-the-Person Chan)

*Menyāolüe* (Summary of the Essentials of the Gates), one fascicle; *Sìjiàoyì* (Meanings of the Four Teachings), one fascicle; *Dìyíguīngbǎilù* (Record of the Hundred Items from Guīngshān Temple), two fascicles; *Sānguàn xīn sòng shí'èrbùjīng yì* (Meanings of the Three Contemplations of Mind and the Recitation of the Twelve Divisions of the Sūtras), one fascicle;

*Tiāntái shì wǎngshēng jìngtǔ wén* (Tiantai’s Vow for Rebirth in the Pure Land), one fascicle; *Nányuè fēixí zuò niànfó sānmèi xù* (Preface to the Samādhi of Buddha-Recitation Composed by Nanyue Feixi), one fascicle; *Huìyuǎn wén* (Writings of Huìyuǎn), one fascicle; *Zhū Fǎhù zèng Ān gōng shū* (Letter Presented to Master Ān by Zhú Fǎhù of the Eastern Jin), one fascicle;

*Shì Dào'ān dá Tàigōng shū* (Letter from Śramaṇa Dào'ān in Reply to Master Tàihé), one fascicle; *Guànshí fǎ* (Method of Contemplating Food), one fascicle; and the aforementioned six fascicles by Tiantai, totaling seven fascicles. Compiled in the Tang dynasty.

One scroll: *Epitaph for the Two Late Virtuous Bhikṣuṇīs of the Fǎhuá Monastery at Tiānxīng Temple in Chángzhōu*. One scroll: *Record of the Donation of Cypress Wood for a Scripture Repository by Shén Bǔquè of the Liáng Dynasty*.

One scroll: *Record of the Three Pavilions of Mount Tiantái*, compiled by Fǎshèng. One scroll: *Record of the Successive Reigns of Emperors* by Lù Zhì, Minister of the Court of Judicial Review of Tàizhōu.

One scroll: *Epitaph for Grand Master Sī of Nányuè*, recorded by Xuánchàng of Xīmíng Temple. One scroll: *Epitaph for Grand Master Zhìzhě of Mount Tiantái during the Sui Dynasty*, composed by Wáng Shìláng of Héngzhōu. [The above was] composed by Wáng Shìláng.

A set of one hanging scroll depicting the footprints of Śākyamuni Tathāgata was commissioned on the twenty-fifth day of the eighth month [of the year] above-mentioned and donated by the Preceptor Guan for perpetual offerings. The twenty-fifth day of the eighth month, the eighth year of the Dazhong era.

Preface to the *Śākyamuni School’s Manual for the Assembly of the Sangha* (one fascicle), composed by National Master Nanshan; Epitaph for the Rebuilt Temple of the Left Ward of the Great Tang (one fascicle), composed by Imperial Decree by Grandee Li; Record of the Affairs of Grand Commandant Li of the South by Sui Yungong (one fascicle); Private Notes on the *Avataṃsaka Sūtra*, Volumes Upper and Lower (two fascicles); Combined Character Dictionary by Lü Cai of Niutou (one fascicle).
